items: HAPPIER GARDENING - Prop up plants, flower pots and garden items above lawns, patios, and decking to rise above the challenges of stains, soil build-up infestation!

ENHANCED Non-slip SURFACE GRIP – Every garden has a variety of surfaces and textures. We crafted a more optimal surface grip that helps connect the underside of the pot foot to a variety of floors. This grip helps to maintain a more practical non-slip contact, which results in a more secure and stable pot!

35G(1.23oz) PER PIECE - Our pot risers are often 2-3x the average weight of the lighter foam material pieces. We craft from a high-quality odourless TRUE EPDM RUBBER, and not from a bad smelling recycled-tyre rubber that is common on the market. Tested with 100kg, you can buy with confidence and avoid concerns of any flattening and compression.

INVISIBLE – No longer fear breaking or tripping over ceramic feet and stands, our feet remain discreetly tucked under pots, allowing your plants and flowers to flourish and compliment your garden – A perfect Plant Caddy!
PACKED WITH VALUE – Crafted from solid high-quality rubber, and integrating a smarter surface grip, with X24 pot feet per pack!
